summary: Hidden files toggle in Settings, folder queue fairness and a fix for the Preferences crash.
changelog: Per account hidden files toggle in Settings, so folders like .private can be synchronized from the interface (#306).
Folders of the same account take turns fairly: continuous changes in one folder no longer starve the rest (#309).
Add Folder lives in Settings > Synchronization instead of a detached button in the account summary (#311).
Opening Preferences no longer aborts the application with a RefCell panic (#307).
